mapper.insert: INSERT INTO communication_post (user_seq, category, title, content) VALUES (#{userSeq}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_seq, p.user_seq, m.user_name AS userName, p.category, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM communication_comment c WHERE c.post_seq = p.post_seq ) AS commentCount FROM communication_post p JOIN member m ON m.user_seq = p.user_seq WHERE p.user_seq = #{userSeq} AND p.created_at >= CURDATE() AND p.created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM communication_post p WHERE p.user_seq = #{userSeq} AND p.created_at >= CURDATE() AND p.created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
